title: The Sun's Blessing
description: The designated Umvuthi offers a service older than the current reign: satisfy his own terms of exchange and receive the native blessing of the Sun through the Grove's existing ritual trade.
description_completed: The Overlord has satisfied Umvuthi's native trade and received the Sun's Blessing from the designated Grove.

dialogue.offer: You have been received in my Grove. If you seek the Sun's favor, bring what I desire and make the exchange according to my law. The blessing is not given for empty words.
dialogue.in_progress: The Sun waits for no boast. Fulfill the exchange, and its power will answer.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: The bargain is fulfilled. You carry the Sun's mark now; even the dark tower cannot pretend otherwise.
dialogue.completed: You have received what this Grove grants. Use it well, ruler of shadows.

prerequisites.name: Complete formal audience with the designated Umvuthi
Remain in neutral standing with the designated Grove

objectives.name: Receive the Sun's Blessing through Umvuthi's native trade
